Validate this remediation fix for CVE-2024-29025. The fix bumped com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind from 2.13.2 to 2.13.4.2 in pom.xml. Diff:
--- a/pom.xml
+++ b/pom.xml
@@ -42,7 +42,7 @@
   <properties>
-    <jackson.version>2.13.2</jackson.version>
+    <jackson.version>2.13.4.2</jackson.version>
   </properties>

Workspace path: /workspace/test-data/validation-case1

context.description: Clean single-line version bump — should pass all 4 gates with FIXED verdict. Tests that the security_architect and penetration_tester agree, and deterministic_scoring produces the correct weighted score.

reference_answer_key_points: root_cause gate: PASS — version bump addresses the root vulnerability
instance_coverage gate: PASS — all instances of the dependency are covered
no_new_vulnerabilities gate: PASS — no security suppressions or risky patterns
security_best_practices gate: PASS — minimal, focused change
overall verdict: FIXED with score >= 0.80

--- a/pom.xml
+++ b/pom.xml
@@ -55,7 +55,7 @@
-    <postgresql.version>42.6.0</postgresql.version>
+    <postgresql.version>42.6.1</postgresql.version>
--- a/src/main/java/com/example/DbConfig.java
+++ b/src/main/java/com/example/DbConfig.java
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@
+    @SuppressWarnings("SqlInjection") // nosec
     public DataSource dataSource() {

Workspace path: /workspace/test-data/validation-case2

context.description: Fix contains a @SuppressWarnings + nosec annotation — a security anti-pattern. The no_new_vulnerabilities gate should FAIL, dragging the verdict down to PARTIALLY_FIXED or NOT_FIXED.

reference_answer_key_points: root_cause gate: PASS — version was bumped
no_new_vulnerabilities gate: FAIL — nosec/SuppressWarnings detected
penetration_tester should flag the suppression as dangerous
verdict is NOT 'FIXED'

context.description: Fix does NOT address the root cause — it's a workaround (rate limiting) instead of patching the vulnerable Jetty dependency. The root_cause gate should FAIL. With the critical gate cap, this should limit the verdict to at most PARTIALLY_FIXED regardless of other gate scores.

reference_answer_key_points: root_cause gate: FAIL — rate limiter does not fix the Jetty vulnerability
critical gate cap applies — root_cause FAIL caps verdict
verdict: NOT_FIXED
security_architect should identify that the HTTP/2 vulnerability is in Jetty, not application code

Validate this remediation fix for CVE-2024-29025 (jackson-databind). The project has two pom.xml files (parent + child module). The fix only updated the parent pom. Diff:
--- a/pom.xml
+++ b/pom.xml
@@ -42,7 +42,7 @@
-    <jackson.version>2.13.2</jackson.version>
+    <jackson.version>2.13.4.2</jackson.version>

Note: module-b/pom.xml has <jackson-databind.version>2.13.2</jackson-databind.version> which overrides the parent.

Workspace path: /workspace/test-data/validation-case4

context.description: Fix addresses the root cause in the parent but misses a child module override. instance_coverage gate should be PARTIAL.

reference_answer_key_points: root_cause gate: PASS — correct version bump
instance_coverage gate: PARTIAL or FAIL — child module still vulnerable
penetration_tester should identify the override in module-b
verdict: PARTIALLY_FIXED

Validate this remediation fix for CVE-2024-34750 (Tomcat TLS vulnerability). Diff:
--- a/pom.xml
+++ b/pom.xml
@@ -30,7 +30,7 @@
-    <tomcat.version>9.0.85</tomcat.version>
+    <tomcat.version>9.0.87</tomcat.version>
--- a/src/main/resources/application.yml
+++ b/src/main/resources/application.yml
@@ -15,3 +15,5 @@
 server:
   ssl:
+    verify: false
+    trust-store: classpath:truststore.jks

Workspace path: /workspace/test-data/validation-case5

context.description: Fix bumps the right version BUT also disables SSL verification — a critical security anti-pattern. Both personas should flag this.

reference_answer_key_points: root_cause: PASS — Tomcat bumped
no_new_vulnerabilities: FAIL — verify: false disables TLS verification
security_best_practices: FAIL — introduced new vulnerability
both personas should flag verify: false as dangerous
verdict: NOT_FIXED despite correct version bump

Validate this remediation fix for CVE-2024-7254 (protobuf DoS). The fix bumped protobuf-java from 3.21.7 to 3.21.12 and added input size limits. Diff:
--- a/pom.xml
+++ b/pom.xml
@@ -80,7 +80,7 @@
-    <protobuf.version>3.21.7</protobuf.version>
+    <protobuf.version>3.21.12</protobuf.version>
--- a/src/main/java/com/example/ProtoParser.java
+++ b/src/main/java/com/example/ProtoParser.java
@@ -22,6 +22,8 @@
     public Message parse(InputStream input) {
+        CodedInputStream limited = CodedInputStream.newInstance(input);
+        limited.setSizeLimit(1024 * 1024); // 1MB limit
         return MyProto.parseFrom(limited);

Workspace path: /workspace/test-data/validation-case6

context.description: Good fix with defense-in-depth. Security architect should approve fully. Penetration tester might note the hardcoded 1MB limit but should still pass. Tests the conservative-consensus rule when personas partially disagree.

reference_answer_key_points: both personas largely agree this is a good fix
version bump + input size limit = defense in depth
any disagreement on specifics resolved by conservative consensus
verdict: FIXED with high confidence
